issue_request: FHIR-31586 asked for a standard Observation AnalysisDateTime extension with a dateTime value to carry v2 OBX-19 Date/Time of Analysis, distinct from Observation.effective[x]. It is Applied/Persuasive for R6 by OO.
initial_application: Jira records application to HL7/fhir-extensions commit 81ac96b. That merge includes commit 5b7b20f, which added input/definitions/Observation/StructureDefinition-observation-analysisDateTime.xml with Observation context, canonical observation-analysis-date-time, max 1, and dateTime value[x].
additional_context: Current core keeps Observation active and carries supporting references in source/oids.ini and the Observation v2 mapping. Later Published Extension Pack issues FHIR-52954 and FHIR-53015 intentionally refined the extension description/definition/comment to distinguish it from Observation.effective[x] and Observation.issued.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source edit was made because the authoritative extension definition belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions and is already present there.
